parsed.summary: The patch introduces a method to ensure the string representation of enum values is the actual value, not the enum member itself.

issues.description: This change may introduce a behavioral regression risk as it alters the string representation of enum values, which could affect existing code that relies on the current behavior.
The patch introduces a new method `__str__` in the `Choices` class, which is a minor style inconsistency with the rest of the codebase.
